## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Percona warns that local engines may reject the OpenAI dimensions field and says to enable forwarding only for supporting models. Ollama independently lists dimensions among supported /v1/embeddings request fields. The generic Percona warning does not establish universal Ollama rejection. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/configure-automatic-embedding.html · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers · also: https://docs.ollama.com/api/openai-compatibility.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Percona documents per-model provider selection: the index model matches catalog modelName, whose embeddingProvider selects the client. The global embedding.providerEndpoint override applies only to VOYAGE; OPENAI_COMPATIBLE models use their catalog endpoint. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-29) — https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/configure-automatic-embedding.html · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers · also: https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/automatic-embedding-with-OpenAI-providers.html, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/configure-automatic-embedding.md
- [statement] Percona distinguishes index sizing from dimension forwarding. For autoEmbed, numDimensions is optional, must match the returned vectors, and supports 1–8192; if omitted, mongot uses the model’s outputDimensions. outputDimensions sizes the index. forwardDimensions defaults to false; enabling it sends the resolved dimension as dimensions. Percona restricts forwarding to models that support configurable dimensions. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-29) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.md · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/configure-automatic-embedding.md, https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.html, https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/configure-automatic-embedding.html, https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/automatic-embedding-with-OpenAI-providers.html
- [statement] Percona’s reference defines batchSize as the maximum number of inputs per request, default 96, and batchTokenLimit as the approximate maximum input-token count per batch, default 120000. Its Ollama setup example explicitly supplies those values. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-29) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.md · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/configure-automatic-embedding.md, https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.html
- [statement] Percona documents optional credentials.apiKey and default authHeaderName Authorization with the Bearer scheme; Azure OpenAI uses authHeaderName api-key. Keyless local engines can use credentials: {}. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-29) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.md · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/configure-automatic-embedding.md, https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/configure-automatic-embedding.html, https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.html
- [statement] Percona marks config.errorHandlingConfig as required for OPENAI_COMPATIBLE models. maxRetries limits retry attempts; initialRetryWaitMs sets the first wait in milliseconds; maxRetryWaitMs caps waits in milliseconds; jitter randomizes the wait. The reference says authentication failures are not transient and are not retried. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-29) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.md · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers · also: https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.html
- [statement] Percona’s Ollama setup example supplies maxRetries 10, initialRetryWaitMs 200, maxRetryWaitMs 10000, and jitter 0.1. These are example values; the reference describes the controls without declaring retry defaults. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-29) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/configure-automatic-embedding.md · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.md, https://docs.percona.com/percona-search-for-mongodb/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.html
- [statement] Percona’s published catalog examples differ: the reference shorthand uses provider and a top-level providerEndpoint, while its settings table names config.providerEndpoint; the setup guide uses embeddingProvider and nests providerEndpoint under config. This records documentation positions without establishing which schema a binary accepts. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-29) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.md · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/configure-automatic-embedding.md
- [statement] Percona’s reference lists config.providerEndpoint as optional with default https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings; modelName is both the index lookup name and the value sent in the request model field. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-29) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/automatic-embedding-configuration-reference.md · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers
- [statement] Percona’s keyless-local-engine configuration agrees with Ollama’s local-server documentation, which says the OpenAI client requires an API-key value but Ollama ignores it. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/percona/percona-search-for-mongodb-docs/main/docs/configure-automatic-embedding.md · keywords: mongot autoEmbed with OpenAI-compatible providers · also: https://docs.ollama.com/api/openai-compatibility
